sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: September 9–10, 2026 Pitchfork and Guardian electronic/experimental coverage was screened. Bitchin Bajas, Black Bananas, Angine de Poitrine and Argento were excluded because their relevant exact tracks or catalogues were already decided, parked, unresolved or inspected in recent runs. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/bitchin-bajas-isle-peaks-ep ; https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/black-bananas-bad-bunch ; https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/argento-miraggi

OVERLOOKED RHYTHM-LED CATALOGUE: Pitchfork's Pangaea — Changing Channels review supplied exact routes through hybrid garage/dub-techno construction, manipulated delay/swing and contrasting rhythmic speeds. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/pangaea-changing-channels

ADJACENT SPARSE PERCUSSION: Pitchfork's Pearson Sound review supplied exact routes through economical drum composition, sparse rhythmic dizziness and unconventional percussive mechanisms. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/20177-pearson-sound

OLDER EXPERIMENTAL CLUB: Pitchfork's exact Xosar track review and Co La album review supplied routes through forceful percussive disorder and sample-built club abstraction. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/tracks/17390-xosar-the-pit ; https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/21078-no-no

FRESHNESS CHECK: repository searches found no durable exact decision, revisit, utility or unresolved entry for the nine requested identities. Runs 125–134 selected ecosystems and Run 133's failed request were not reused.
exclusions: Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, existing utility discoveries and prior unresolved leads without materially new identity evidence were excluded.
Current September coverage of Bitchin Bajas, Black Bananas, Angine de Poitrine and Argento was screened but excluded because the useful identities or catalogue windows were already persistent.
Pangaea, Pearson Sound, Xosar and Co La tracks lacking at least a concrete exact-track or release-context rhythmic hypothesis were inspected but excluded.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
